# Hehe — Product Brief

*Generated by Sutra Onboarding Process — Phase 2 Output*

---

## Intake Card

```
COMPANY: Hehe
ONE-LINER: A humor app that makes people laugh, powered by AI + curated content
USER: Anyone having a rough moment who needs a quick hit of joy
CURRENT ALT: Reddit (time sink), Twitter/X (toxic), texting funny friends (unavailable), TikTok (addictive, mostly not funny)
SWITCH REASON: Hehe is ONLY humor. No doom-scrolling, no politics, no ads between jokes. Open → laugh → close. 30 seconds.
FIRST VERSION: Web app with joke feed, AI-generated humor, one-tap share
CORE BET: People will return daily to a dedicated humor app if the hit rate is >70% funny
PLATFORM: Web (fast to ship, no app store)
```

---

## PR/FAQ

FOR anyone having a bad day WHO wants to laugh without scrolling through garbage,
HEHE IS A humor-only web app
THAT delivers a personalized stream of jokes, memes, and AI-generated comedy in under 30 seconds.
UNLIKE Reddit or TikTok where funny content is buried in noise,
HEHE is 100% humor, zero filler, and learns what makes YOU laugh.

---

## P0 Feature Carve

| Feature | P0? | Why |
|---------|-----|-----|
| Joke feed (scrollable) | YES | This IS the product. No feed, no product. |
| AI-generated jokes | YES | The differentiator. Personalized, infinite supply. |
| Categories (dad jokes, dark, puns, absurd, observational) | YES | People's humor varies wildly. Must filter. |
| One-tap share (copy to clipboard) | YES | Jokes spread by sharing. This is the growth loop. |
| Upvote/downvote per joke | YES | Trains the recommendation. Without this, no personalization. |
| User accounts / login | NO | Anonymous first. Add auth later for saved preferences. |
| Meme generation | NO | Cool but not P0. Text jokes first. |
| User-submitted jokes | NO | Moderation nightmare at this stage. |
| Comments | NO | This isn't social media. Read, laugh, share, leave. |
| Push notifications | NO | Web first, and we haven't earned the right to notify. |
| Dark mode | NO | Nice to have. Ship light mode, add dark in week 2. |
| Trending/viral jokes | NO | Need data first. Can't trend with 0 users. |

**P0 scope: Feed + AI jokes + categories + share + vote. That's it.**

---

## Risk Map

| Risk | Likelihood | Mitigation |
|------|-----------|------------|
| AI jokes aren't funny | HIGH | Curate a seed library of 500+ human-written jokes. AI supplements, doesn't replace. Test hit rate before launch. |
| Nobody comes back after day 1 | MEDIUM | Daily "joke of the day" hook. Fresh content on every visit. Track D1/D7 retention from day one. |
| Content moderation (offensive jokes) | MEDIUM | Category system lets users opt in/out. AI generation uses guardrails. Flag system for inappropriate content. |

---

## V1 Description

A single-page web app. You open it, you see a joke. Swipe or tap for next. Pick your humor style (dad jokes, dark, absurd, puns, observational). Upvote what's funny, downvote what's not. Share any joke with one tap. No login required. Works on phone browser, tablet, desktop.

The feed mixes curated human-written jokes (seeded) with AI-generated jokes (Gemini/Claude). Over time, the ratio shifts based on what gets upvoted.

**Tech stack**: Next.js (web), Supabase (backend, auth later, DB now), Gemini API (joke generation), Vercel (deploy).

**Ship target**: Deployed and live in one session.

---

## What Success Looks Like (Week 1)

- App is live on a URL anyone can visit
- 500+ jokes in the seed library
- AI generates new jokes on demand
- Share button works (clipboard copy)
- Vote system records preferences
- Load time < 2 seconds
- Hit rate: >50% of jokes get upvote (measured)
